page.title: Goals
page.purpose: Show outcomes, milestone status, linked work, and time allocation so a person can see which goals receive attention — without treating elapsed hours as achievement.

priorities.statement: Linked hours are shown as effort exposure, visually distinct from outcome progress; a goal with no linked work and work with no goal are both valid, legible states.
A milestone shows its observable completion criteria and what evidence is missing; a non-empty checklist is not presented as a finished deliverable.
Manual outcome updates and work-derived indicators are always distinguishable.

states.description: Goals, milestones, and linked-work rollups resolve.
Goals with progress method, milestone status, and linked work are visible.
No goals yet: explain that maintenance, rest, and obligations are valid uses of time without a productivity goal, and offer to add one.
A milestone's completion evidence is incomplete: show what is missing rather than a false 'done'.
A milestone forecast is stale after an input change: mark why and recompute rather than showing an old outlook as current.
A load failed: retain last-known goal state with a retry.
